app.name: Super Spine Viewer
app.tagline: Load and export Spine animations in the browser, with transparent video

dropzone.title: Drop Spine assets here
dropzone.hint: Needs a .skel / .json skeleton, an .atlas file and its texture PNGs; a whole folder is fine

preview.empty: No skeleton loaded yet — drop some files first

control.disabledHint: Playback and transform controls unlock once a skeleton is loaded

errors.missingTextures: Texture pages referenced by the atlas are missing: {{names}}
errors.unknownVersion: Could not tell which Spine version this file came from — make sure these are files exported from Spine
errors.runtime2d: Resources exported by Spine 2.x cannot be opened (this older format is not supported yet)
errors.runtimeFuture: Assets from newer Spine versions are not supported yet (closest available runtime: {{version}})
errors.allCandidatesFailed: These files could not be opened: {{detail}}
errors.binaryUnsupported: Set "Spine runtime" back to "Auto-detect" and try again

warnings.skeletonFallback: {{from}} could not be opened, switched to {{to}}
warnings.runtimeFallback: Opened with the Spine {{to}} runtime instead of {{from}}
warnings.manualRuntime: Opened with the {{pack}} runtime you selected
